name: Trip quiz
summary: A story quiz made from a trip's moments, each question over a drawn scene from the trip with four friends or answers to pick; picks go green or red like the quiz sticker, and the end shows your score beside everyone else's and who got every one.
useWhen: make a quiz about the lake wren trip for my story
who remembers the weekend best, quiz on the trip
story quiz with questions like who fell off the paddleboard
trip recap but as a game the group can play
quiz the six on spring break moments
dontUseWhen: a photo recap without questions (use trip-story or album)
guessing who said a message (use who-said-it)

trip.description: The trip's name, e.g. 'Lake Wren weekend'

ago.description: How long ago it went up, e.g. '1d'

questions.description: Two to six questions about moments from the trip

scene.description: Which drawn scene sits behind the question

q.description: The question, lower case like a story sticker

options.description: 2 to 4 answers; friends' names show their faces

played.description: Friends who already played and the option they picked for each question, in order
